name: CITY COUNCIL MEETING
agenda_text:
CITY COUNCIL MEETING
AGENDA FOR LA MIRADA CITY COUNCIL MEETING
May 28, 2024 –
6:30
p.m.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, CITY HALL, 13700 LA MIRADA BOULEVARD,
LA MIRADA, CALIFORNIA 90638
In-Person Public Participation Information
To address the City Council on an Agenda item other than a Public Hearing or during Public
Comments, please fill out a "Request to Address Council" card located in the back of the Council
Chambers near the agendas and submit to the City Clerk prior to the meeting or as soon as
possible. There is a five minute maximum time limit when addressing the City Council. The amount
of time for public comment may be reduced by the Mayor or by action of the City Council
Electronic Public Participation
To submit your Public Comments electronically in advance, please email your written comments to
cityclerk@lamirada.gov. The deadline to submit your Public Comment electronically is on the day
of a regular City Council meeting before 3 p.m. For special meetings, comments must be received
at least three hours prior to the meeting.
Members of the public may participate in this meeting via remote attendance by using the Zoom
Webinar information.
Zoom Meeting Details: www.zoom.us/join
Meeting ID: 897 8121 0338 Telephone Option: 1-669-444-9171
(*6 to unmute; *9 to raise hand)
Public Comment will begin with speakers attending in-person first followed by those attending via
Zoom Webinar.
Reasonable Accommodations
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City Council meeting or other service offered by the City, contact the City Clerk's Office at
(562) 943-0131. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are
needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide
accessibility to the meeting or service.
Agenda Materials
Copies of staff reports and supporting documentation pertaining to agenda items are available for
public viewing and inspection at City Hall during regular business hours and on the City's website
http://www.lamirada.gov. For further information regarding agenda items, please contact the
City Clerk's office at (562) 943-0131.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
INVOCATION: Deacon Paul Machuca, Beatitudes of Our Lord Church
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: VFW Post 9148
4.
ROLL CALL:
Councilmember De Ruse
Councilmember Otero
Mayor Pro Tem Eng
Mayor Lewis
5.
APPEARANCES, PRESENTATIONS, AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.1
RECOGNITION OF LA MIRADA SOCCER ASSOCIATION'S BOYS LA MIRADA FOOTBALL CLUB TEAM - It is recommended the City Council recognize the athletes and coaches of the La Mirada Football Club and present them with Certificates of Recognition.
5.1 Recognition of La Mirada Football Club
5.2
RECOGNITION OF CITY EMPLOYEES FOR YEARS OF SERVICE - It is recommended the City Council recognize Priscilla Yi and Casem Talbot for their years of service and present each of them with a service award pin and a certificate of appreciation.
5.2 Recognition of City Employees
6.
PUBLIC COMMENT
7.
APPOINTMENTS
7.1
APPOINTMENTS TO THE LA MIRADA YOUTH COUNCIL - It is recommended the City Council appoint Isabelle Alejandre, Lianna Blancoromero, Katherine Jimenez, Ethan Hall, Miso Hong, Daniel Morales, Madison Souza, and Emma Vanden Dries to the La Mirada Youth Council for the term expiring in October 2024.
7.1 Appointments to YC
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR: (All items listed on the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine matters, status reports or subjects covered previously by the City Council. Items listed on the Consent Calendar may be enacted in one motion.)
8.1
APPROVAL OF MEETING MINUTES - It is recommended the City Council approve the minutes of the Study Session meeting of May 14, 2024 and the minutes of the regular City Council meeting of May 14, 2024.
8.1 Minutes of 5-14-24 SS
8.1 Minutes of 5-14-24 CC
8.2
APPROVAL OF WARRANT REGISTER - It is recommended the City Council approve the warrant register dated May 28, 2024 in the total amount of $3,484,160.11.
8.2 Warrant Register
8.3
FIRST AMENDMENT TO THE COMMUNICATIONS FACILITY LEASE BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA MIRADA AND LOS ANGELES SMSA LIMITED PARTNERSHIP DBA VERIZON WIRELESS - It is recommended the City Council approve the First Amendment to the Communications Site Lease Agreement between the City of La Mirada and Los Angeles SMSA Limited Partnership dba Verizon Wireless, subject to the lease agreement terms, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
8.3 Communications Facility Lease
8.4
APPROVAL OF SPECIAL EVENT PARKING ON FOSTER ROAD FOR LA MIRADA HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION CEREMONY - It is recommended the City Council approve Special Event Parking on the north and south sides of Foster Road between Santa Gertrudes Avenue and Lisburn Place on June 5 from 3 p.m. to 10 p.m.
8.4 Special Event Parking
8.5
INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE CITY OF LA MIRADA FOR THE MONTH ENDING APRIL 2024 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Investment Report for the month ending April 2024.
8.5 Investment Report for April
8.6
ANNUAL INVESTMENT REPORT AS OF APRIL 2024 - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the City’s Annual Investment Report as of April 2024.
8.6 Annual Investment Report
8.7
STATEMENT OF INVESTMENT POLICY - It is recommended the City Council receive and file the Statement of Investment Policy of the City of La Mirada for Fiscal Year 2024-25.
8.7 Statement of Investment Policy
8.8
APPROVAL OF FACILITY USE FOR THE LA MIRADA-WHITTIER AMERICAN CANCER SOCIETY RELAY FOR LIFE FUNDRAISING EVENT - It is recommended the City Council approve the request for use of Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center for the American Cancer Society Relay for Life fundraiser event and waive all rental fees associated with the requested use.
8.8 Approval of Facility Use
8.9
CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT NO. 2022-02, SLURRY SEAL OF ROSECRANS AVENUE FROM VALLEY VIEW AVENUE TO EAST CITY LIMITS, LA MIRADA BOULEVARD FROM LEFFINGWELL ROAD TO ALONDRA BOULEVARD, AND HILLSBOROUGH DRIVE FROM BEACH BOULEVARD TO EAST CITY LIMITS – APPROVAL OF CONTRACT CHANGE ORDER - It is recommended the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute Contract Change Order No. 3 in an amount not to exceed $171,279.87.
8.9 CIP No. 2022-02
9.
ORDINANCES AND RESOLUTIONS
9.1
RESOLUTION NOS. 24-06, 24-07, AND 24-08 REGARDING THE CITY OF LA MIRADA SPECIAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION TO BE HELD NOVEMBER 5, 2024 - It is recommended the City Council adopt Resolution No. 24-06 calling for a Special Municipal Election to be held on Tuesday, November 5, 2024, for the election of a Councilmember to represent Council District 2 as required by the provisions of the laws of the State of California relating to General Law cities; adopt Resolution No. 24-07 requesting the Board of Supervisors of the County of Los Angeles to consolidate a Special Municipal Election to be held November 5, 2024 with the Presidential Election to be held on the date pursuant to § 10403 of the Elections Code; and adopt Resolution No. 24-08 adopting regulations for candidates and candidate statements.
9.1 Special Municipal Election Resolutions
